coachView.name: MultiSelect
coachView.layout:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><ns2:layout xmlns:ns2="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/CoachDesignerNG" xmlns:ns3="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/coachview"><ns2:layoutItem xsi:type="ns2:CustomHTML" version="8550" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><ns2:id>b9bf9b3d-f7c9-4308-b314-2a1c29824396</ns2:id><ns2:layoutItemId>CustomHTML1</ns2:layoutItemId><ns2:configData><ns2:id>ad81ecd8-53b3-49e6-94fd-d9b9d5cc2003</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.contentType</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>TEXT</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>bf4026a0-a9fc-4b4e-bc73-fc6957d5fab0</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.textContent</ns2:optionName><ns2:value><div class="multiselect-container" role="region" aria-label="Multi-select dropdown">
  <div class="multiselect-wrapper">
    <div class="multiselect-input-wrapper" role="combobox" aria-expanded="false" aria-haspopup="listbox">
      <div class="multiselect-selected-items">
        <span class="multiselect-placeholder">Select items...</span>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="multiselect-toggle" aria-label="Toggle dropdown">
        <svg class="multiselect-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M8 11L3 6 3.7 5.3 8 9.6 12.3 5.3 13 6z"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="multiselect-dropdown" role="listbox" aria-multiselectable="true">
      <div class="multiselect-search-wrapper">
        <input type="text" class="multiselect-search" placeholder="Search..." aria-label="Search items">
        <svg class="multiselect-search-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M15 14.3L10.7 10c.9-1.2 1.5-2.7 1.5-4.2 0-3.7-3-6.8-6.7-6.8S-1.2 2.1-1.2 5.8s3 6.8 6.7 6.8c1.8 0 3.4-.7 4.6-1.8L14.3 15 15 14.3zM5.5 11.3c-3 0-5.5-2.5-5.5-5.5S2.5.3 5.5.3 11 2.8 11 5.8s-2.5 5.5-5.5 5.5z"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="multiselect-options">
        <!-- Options will be dynamically generated -->
      </div>
      <div class="multiselect-actions">
        <button type="button" class="multiselect-action-btn multiselect-select-all">Select All</button>
        <button type="button" class="multiselect-action-btn multiselect-clear-all">Clear All</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="multiselect-helper-text"></div>
</div></ns2:value></ns2:configData></ns2:layoutItem></ns2:layout>
coachView.description: Multi-select dropdown widget with search and bulk selection capabilities for IBM Business Automation Workflow

configOption.name: options
configOption.label: Options
configOption.description: Array of available options with value and name properties

configOption.name: placeholder
configOption.label: Placeholder
configOption.description: Placeholder text when no items are selected

configOption.name: maxSelections
configOption.label: Max Selections
configOption.description: Maximum number of items that can be selected (null = no limit)

configOption.name: showSearch
configOption.label: Show Search
configOption.description: Show/hide search input for filtering options

configOption.name: showActions
configOption.label: Show Actions
configOption.description: Show/hide Select All and Clear All buttons

configOption.name: helperText
configOption.label: Helper Text
configOption.description: Helper text displayed below the widget
